abstract: Motivated by the recent observation that rotating space–times at finite temperature can be described by particular flat, compact, orientable manifolds, which are different from <math altimg="si1.svg" display="inline" id="d1e788"><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="double-struck">T</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup></math>, we catalogue all such 4-manifolds and their properties. There are in total 26 flat, compact, orientable 4-manifolds, 23 of them spin-manifolds, so fermions and a Dirac operator can also be defined on these. Seven of them are appropriate for finite volume periodic boxes undergoing rotation at finite temperature.
title: QFT on flat, compact, orientable manifolds
